summary: Amber_4 soft-delete + undo + reupload + re-analysis banner fully verified. Created pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_amber4_softdelete.py with 14 tests covering soft-delete flags, recompute counts, needs_reanalysis flag, undo restore (including replaced+purge-new), reupload, edge cases (double-delete 400, undo-of-live 400, 404s, reupload-of-deleted 400), analysis filter excluding is_deleted records + flag clearing on success, and background _undo_window_purger via past timestamp injection. Full regression: 80/80 pass (66 Amber_1/2/3 + 14 Amber_4). Frontend Playwright verified: Overview is default tab, delete shows amber banner + strike-through row with countdown 'Deleted · undo in 2m 59s' + Undo button + Pending deletions badge; reupload toast 'File replaced'; undo after reupload restores old and purges new; banner button data-testid='reanalysis-banner-btn' works.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 695 lines — approaching the 700-line threshold; consider splitting case/upload/analysis routers into separate modules for maintainability.
_undo_window_purger ticks every 60s — for a 180s undo window worst-case purge lag is 60s, which is fine; documented in tests with 80s wait.

_maybe_clear_reanalysis_flag uses ISO-string comparison (last_change <= analysis_at). Works because both are timezone-aware ISO8601 with same offset, but a future code change that drops timezone could break ordering silently. Consider parsing to datetime before comparing.
Reupload error path (parse failure) raises HTTPException AFTER writing the new temp file but BEFORE soft-deleting old upload — good, old upload is preserved. Verified no rollback needed.
DELETE /cases/{id} hard-deletes everything including any in-flight soft-deleted uploads — intentional, but worth noting it bypasses the undo window.
test_credentials: N/A — no auth in this app
seed_data_creation: Each test creates a TEST_Amber4 case + 1 upload via fixture; teardown deletes the case. Existing analyzed case 77aa1a27-... used only for read-only frontend smoke.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pytest suite under /app/backend/tests/ now has 80 tests across Amber_1/2/3/4. test_amber4_softdelete.py includes a 60-70s background-purger test (TestBackgroundPurger). To run faster, deselect it: pytest --deselect tests/test_amber4_softdelete.py::TestBackgroundPurger. UNDO_WINDOW_SECONDS=180 in server.py is unchanged. Frontend testids in CaseView.js: reanalysis-banner, reanalysis-banner-btn, upload-row-{n}, undo-upload-{n}, reupload-upload-{n}, delete-upload-{n}, countdown-{n}, reupload-hidden-input. Banner remains visible after undo if last analysis is older than the deletion event (by design per _maybe_clear_reanalysis_flag).
